home.subtitle: Local startup & requirements
home.heading: Installation diagnostics
home.firstRun: SMN is not installed on this computer yet. You can set it up in a few clicks.
home.willPrepare: A dedicated database will be prepared only after you confirm installation.
home.noAutoSetup: No database or account is created when the server starts. Private routes require a valid session.

login.title: Sign in to Scrum Master Notebook
login.intro: Use the username or email address configured during installation.
login.pilotInfo: If you kept the pilot defaults during installation, the initial account is admin / admin. You must change the password before accessing the application.
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in fifteen minutes.
login.unavailable: The SMN database is unavailable. Check that it is running, then try again.

diagnostic.configuration-missing: The SMN database connection has not been configured.
diagnostic.configuration-invalid: SMN must target a dedicated local PostgreSQL database.
diagnostic.database-missing: The SMN database does not exist yet. The upcoming installer will request confirmation before creating it.
diagnostic.connection-error: Could not connect to PostgreSQL. Check the local service and settings, then retry.
diagnostic.permissions-insufficient: The PostgreSQL account lacks the permissions required to inspect this installation.
diagnostic.server-version-unsupported: This PostgreSQL version has not been qualified for SMN I0. Check for version 18.
diagnostic.virgin: An empty SMN database was detected. You can review the installation preparation.
diagnostic.initialized: An existing SMN installation was found. Authentication will be required to access data.
diagnostic.schema-incompatible: The database schema is not recognized. No automatic changes will be applied.
diagnostic.installation-incomplete: The installation appears incomplete. Private data access remains blocked.
